reasons.invoice_predates_loss: The invoice is dated 2026-09-20, two days before the 2026-09-22 loss.
reasons.claim_decision: The witness reports an unscheduled old oven was moved before the loss, so refer the equipment part to SIU and do not pay it; the evidence does not establish that building cover is undisputed.
reasons.scheduled_coverage_fit: The policy lists two deck ovens, a mixer, and a cooler, but the claim gives no itemized inventory, a witness identifies an unscheduled old oven, and the equipment amount exceeds the listed sum insured.
